body:
## ANTI-AI-SLOP
Monolithic PR scope creep found.

## FINDINGS
PR #148 bundles multiple unrelated features into a single pull request, violating our scope creep guidelines. It mixes the Contact page refactor with the PageHeader standardization affecting multiple pages, and introduces a completely new animation system (`src/lib/animations.ts`). Please split this PR into three standalone, focused pull requests: one for the Contact page, one for the PageHeader standardization, and one for the animation infrastructure.

## FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Not Approved

comments.body: This contact page refactor looks comprehensive, but it's bundled with unrelated architectural changes. We already have PR #106 handling the contact form UX in a localized way. If we move forward with this version, it needs to be decoupled from the PageHeader and animation changes.
This new animation infrastructure should be its own dedicated PR. Coupling it with the Contact page refactor makes review difficult and introduces unnecessary risk.
These PageHeader standardizations affect the entire application and should be reviewed independently in a separate PR.
